title: Generalize Forms Blueprint Into Protocol Technology
description:
Generalize the "Blueprint" builder mode inside forms/plugin/rs (a strict, ordered list of steps containing typed blocks with add/remove/reorder/drag-drop chrome and module-contributed block kinds) into a new first-class, full-blown technology called `protocol`: a Blockly-like visual editor for generating code/data that is strictly list-based (no canvas/map), module-based (extensible block kinds via a Contribution mechanism), and follows every existing semio convention (workspace crate layout, framework/core <-> framework/renderer/react host registration, semio UI style).

Scope (see full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/forms-is-using-in-snoopy-liskov.md):
1. New `protocol/rs` domain crate (crate `protocol`): generalized from forms/rs/lib.rs — ProtocolSpec/ProtocolStep/ProtocolBlock/ProtocolExpr/ProtocolOp/ProtocolDiff/PROTOCOL_BUILTIN_KINDS/wasm_bridge (ProtocolDocumentVcs), depends on vcs same as forms/rs does today.
2. New `protocol/plugin/rs` crate: standalone "Protocol" app/plugin, mirrors vcs/plugin/rs structure ([package.metadata.component] package="semio:protocol"), uses a new shared framework/plugin/rs::protocol_mode module (generic step/block CRUD + ProtocolListScene building), independently launchable with its own example fixture under protocol/example/.
3. New `protocol/module/procedural/rs` crate: relocated from forms/module/procedural/rs, contributes a block kind via the new Contribution::ProtocolBlockKind (renamed from Contribution::FormsQuestionKind, field questionKind->blockKind) in framework/core/rs/lib.rs.
4. framework/core/rs/lib.rs: add SurfaceKind::ProtocolList, Contribution::ProtocolBlockKind, a new ProtocolListScene type in the ComponentScenes region, and a protocolList variant on UiComponentSceneNode.
5. framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs: new shared protocol_mode module (mirrors the existing generate_mode module reused by procedural/plugin and flow/plugin) implementing the generic strict-list builder engine (add/remove/move-step, add/remove/move-block, drag-and-drop reorder, ProtocolBuilderConfig for action-namespace/labels/palette resolution) and build_protocol_list_scene(...).
6. New framework/renderer/react/components/protocol-list-host.tsx: dedicated React host using @dnd-kit (already available via ui/js/react/index.tsx) for a sortable block list + module-contributed block palette, following the exact host conventions of the other 11 hosts in that directory (root class semio-protocol-list-host, data-surface-id, Tailwind-only styling with semantic tokens, useMemo+try/catch JSON parsing, onAction dispatch, //#region organization, @emoji docstrings). Register "protocol-list" in framework/renderer/react/ui-interpreter.tsx's lazy-import list and componentKind switch. Add re-exports in framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx for the new types (ProtocolListScene, ProtocolBlockKind contribution type) per the pattern established by the closed CONSOLIDATE-PROTOCOL-TYPES-INTO-FRAMEWORK-CORE ticket (types live in framework/core/js/index.ts, os-shell re-exports the subset components import by path).
7. Refactor forms/rs/lib.rs: strip out everything now generalized into protocol/rs (FormSpec/FormStep/FormQuestion/FormExpr/FormOp/FormDiff/FORM_BUILTIN_KINDS/generic list-traversal helpers), keep only genuinely forms-specific Try-wizard state/runtime (FormsPlayEnvelope etc.), building on protocol::{ProtocolSpec, ProtocolBlock, ...} directly.
8. Refactor forms/plugin/rs/lib.rs: delete render_blueprint_builder/builder_step_section/builder_question_card/builder_button/builder_text_editor (lines ~1152-1186 and their upstream definitions); FORMS_PLAY_BODY_BLUEPRINT dispatch now calls framework_plugin::protocol_mode::render_protocol_builder(&spec, ProtocolBuilderConfig{action_namespace:"forms-blueprint",...}, contributions). Keep element ids prefixed "forms-blueprint.*" (framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts:367,375 asserts on this). Leave the Try wizard (render_try_question etc, ~line 1189+) untouched.
9. Workspace wiring: add protocol/rs, protocol/plugin/rs, protocol/module/procedural/rs to root Cargo.toml [workspace] members; remove forms/module/procedural/rs. Update framework/plugin/rs/Cargo.toml, forms/rs/Cargo.toml, forms/plugin/rs/Cargo.toml, protocol/module/procedural/rs/Cargo.toml dependencies accordingly (same dependency shape protocol/module/procedural needs as old forms/module/procedural: flow_core, flow_module_brep, kernel_3d_brepkit, kernel_3d_engine, semio-framework-plugin, semio-framework-core, now depending on protocol instead of forms). Add package.json/project.json/script.ts for protocol/rs and protocol/plugin/rs copying the WasmScript/TestScript pattern from vcs/rs and vcs/plugin/rs. New protocol/AGENTS.md (technology: protocol frontmatter). Register protocol dev/build/test entries in .vscode/launch.json following the existing emoji-grouped naming convention next to vcs/forms entries.

Constraints (repo CLAUDE.md): greenfield, no back-compat/migration shims — delete/rename outright, no deprecated re-exports beyond what's needed for existing import paths within this refactor. No git commands (concurrent devs). Edit existing files in place, use #region/#endregion (Rust: pub mod regions) when adding to large existing files. No comments inside definitions; one-line @emoji-prefixed docstrings only where non-obvious. Do not create project.json/package.json outside the script.ts-calls-nx pattern. Do not touch AGENTS.md files other than creating the new protocol/AGENTS.md.

Verification: cargo build --workspace; cargo test -p protocol; bun nx run @semio-tech/protocol-rs:test; bun nx run @semio-tech/forms-rs:test; bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-renderer-react:test; then drive both the standalone Protocol app and forms' Blueprint mode end-to-end in the browser preview (add/remove/reorder steps+blocks, drag palette block into list, confirm protocol-list-host.tsx renders with no console errors), and confirm protocol/module/procedural's contributed block kind still renders its 3D preview/params panel inside forms' Blueprint mode via the extension slot.
